decision_rule: Retain an improvement as useful when mean executable return improves on more than half of matched dates and overextension does not increase. Report risk improvements separately. Never promote automatically.
limitations: Fresh one-seed models replace deleted historical weights. Each date contains an outcome-independent 32-stock evaluation sample, so Top10 results estimate ranking behavior within that sample rather than full-market live returns. Daily highs and lows are scenario prices and do not establish intraday order, fills, slippage or capacity.
